basic_info.description: Nestled b/w Buena Vista Park & Panhandle, this 4bd, 2ba urban oasis offers flexible living spaces, original details & modern updates throughout its 2,150 SqFt of grand-scale living. With abundant natural light, stunning views & a thoughtfully designed layout, this home blends historic charm with contemporary comfort.  The spacious front bedroom boasts south-facing barrel bay windows, gas fireplace and built-in shelving, while the adjoining room is perfect as a dressing room, office, nursery, or guest bedroom. Down the hall, another bright bedroom features an eastern bay window, & a 4th bedroom showcases another elegant decorative fireplace. The expansive, sunlit living room is framed by northern and eastern views, creating an inviting retreat. The dramatic formal dining room, with a gas fireplace, sets the stage for memorable gatherings. The kitchen is designed to inspire, with exposed brick, subway tile, a center island, quartz countertops & ss appliances. Additionally, the flat includes two well-appointed full bathrooms with Toto Washlets, in-unit W/D, and a private storage area in the basement. New double-pane barrel bay windows (80K fix).Located in one of SF's most sought after locale near BV Park, Panhandle, fab restaurants, nightlife & more!
